changelog: - Org admins get their own mail log (#3955): `/admin/mail-log` (`GET /api/admin/mail-log`, `mail.read`) lists the e-mails to the organization's own people — sent, failed, skipped and why, retrying, held for approval — filterable by status, type, recipient and 7/30 days. Only rows stamped with the admin's organization; rows without one and deployment-wide figures stay the super admin's. In every vertical, MARKETING included.

en: Admins can now see whether an e-mail to someone in their organization went out — and if not, why — under "Mail log".
tr: Yöneticiler artık org'larındaki birine giden bir e-postanın gidip gitmediğini — gitmediyse nedenini — "E-posta kaydı" altında görebiliyor.
de: Admins sehen jetzt unter „E-Mail-Protokoll“, ob eine E-Mail an jemanden aus ihrer Organisation versendet wurde – und wenn nicht, warum.
